issues.where: left sky outside the sunlit limb (also native crops I in image-06.png and J, O in image-07.png)
issues.what: a curved circular patch boundary abruptly cuts off the Milky Way dust, background stars, and warm atmospheric glow into empty black space
issues.fix: remove the circular mask around the globe and extend the skybox starfield and atmospheric scatter continuously to all frame edges

issues.where: central sunlit cloud deck near the terminator in crop A (also image-01.png, image-05.png, and crop A in image-06.png)
issues.what: a vertical UV longitude seam runs top-to-bottom down the globe where diagonal cloud streaks kink sharply into a V-shaped chevron that rotates with the sphere
issues.fix: make the cloud map seamless across the 0/360-degree longitude wrap or generate cloud flow with seamless 3D spherical noise

issues.where: planet limb on both the bright upper-left edge and dark lower-right edge (crops B, D, E, I in image-02.png and image-06.png; crops K, L, R in image-03.png and image-07.png)
issues.what: jagged 1-pixel stair-stepping along the hard geometric sphere edge, plus a doubled orange atmospheric rim separated by a dark gap along the night-side limb
issues.fix: supersample or anti-alias the planet silhouette and replace the hard-clipped outer shell with a single continuous volumetric atmospheric falloff

issues.where: cloud tops along the terminator, polar vortex grazing limb, and night-side lightning (crops L, Q in image-03.png and image-07.png; crops A, I in image-02.png and image-06.png)
issues.what: stretched diagonal cloud streaks and visible blocky texels on high-contrast cloud edges and purple lightning bolts, with broken 1-pixel stair-stepped orange arcs near the grazing limb of the polar vortex
issues.fix: use higher-resolution cloud, displacement, and lightning textures or shader-space procedural detail with proper filtering at grazing angles

issues.where: Milky Way backdrop and inner limb glow (crops K, R in image-03.png and image-07.png; crops F, G, H in image-02.png and image-06.png)
issues.what: the Milky Way plate looks soft and blocky with blurry star blobs beneath sharp 1-pixel overlay stars, and background stars shine unattenuated through the dense bright inner atmospheric limb glow
issues.fix: replace the upscaled Milky Way backdrop with a crisp native-resolution star plate and attenuate background stars by atmospheric optical depth near the limb

issues.where: sunlit disk, vortex, and upper cloud bands
issues.what: ridges read as combed painted strokes and sculpted impasto, smeared along the flow, not soft vapor
issues.fix: break the long strokes into small turbulent vapor and soften the embossed relief

issues.what: cloud structure flattens to a murky field with only faint streaks
issues.fix: keep a low level of cloud relief through the shadow instead of a smooth murk

issues.where: nearest dark cloud strip, lower left
issues.what: the near shadow goes smooth and empty, with noise in place of cloud structure
issues.fix: carry the mid-deck turbulence into the near shadow
